msg: There are four different color gnomes that you can select. You will always be given the opportunity of choosing between two different colors. The same two gnomes will always be on the same screen together. Gnomes of the same color will always bring you to the same forest. I believe that you can "exhaust" the mushroom supply in any given forest. Because of this, I feel that you should go with the same color gnome for several times in a row before eventually switching to the other color gnome that shares his screen. I believe this is the way to best maximize the mushroom yield.
